Indian passport ranking declines in Global Passport Index

The Indian passport has seen a decline in its global ranking according to the Global Passport Index 2026. While one report indicates it slipped one position to 125th, another suggests it maintained the 127th rank from 2021-2024. The index highlights Europe's dominance in the top rankings, with the Indian passport offering visa-free access to 26 countries.
